verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a terminal coding agent, so turning a sketch, image, or PDF design into a working app is a fair question for this product type. However, the evidence pack never documents image, sketch, or PDF input, or any design-to-app generation. The docs cover TUI coding, headless mode, sessions, MCP, and permissions, but nothing about visual or document inputs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
